g.text: MarieRank3Convo2 begins.
Update boolean MarieLyonAvailable
Check boolean LoidFamilyComplete
I hope you do not think me infirme... but I get the strangest sensation sometimes as though I have done this before ?
true
Check boolean MarieFamily1
false
Had these conversations... met these people... though it is impossible, non ?
Will you tell me more of le Cardinal's famille ? I am fascinated to know of his past.
true
Will you tell me of le Cardinal's famille ? I am fascinated to know of his past.
false
+20 Chemistry
I'll tell you all I know, but I'm afraid I don't know as much as you might think.
Oh. Sure, but... wouldn't Loid be the better person to talk to?
[End.]
We call it déjà vu. Must be because of the sérum and the time travel. C'est la vie !
Whatever you can tell me, I shall cherish. Promis !
Speaking of le Cardinal... seems to hurt Monsieur Loid quite deeply. I do not like to do so overmuch.
Chat ends.
Chat ends.
Especially as I do it avec une certaine joie, which no one else seems to do.
Who do you want to know about?
Well, there's Mother, Father, Son, Daughter, and Grandmother upstairs.
Settle one thing first, will you ? The devil laughs at me every time I ask, as if it is a private joke. Grand-mère. Grandmother.
That is not le Cardinal's wife, non ?
No, that's Father's mother. Mother's mother-in-law.
Je... vois. And... why do they not go by their names ? Ne serait-ce pas plus simple ?
Do you want the long story?
I'll give you the short of it.
Oui ! I have nowhere else to be for a little while.
The family upstairs was trapped here when the Orokin Empire collapsed. Son, Entrati's grandson, let the Infestation in.
Well, we are on a moon called Deimos. And a biological bomb was detonated here, long ago, in a desperate attempt to repel the Sentients.
Par Sol ! On purpose ?
The ones the Orokin were at war with, long ago ? The ones we see in the Dark Refractory with the devil, oui ?
Check /Lotus/Scripts/1999/DialogueScriptNodes.lua:IsSyndicateRank
Yes. They tried to harness the Infestation to fight the Sentients. But Deimos became overrun. They locked themselves in the Necralisk - which is above us - for shelter.
No, I think it was an accident. I think he means well.
true
I don't know the truth yet, but I'll reserve judgement until I know more.
true
false
I don't know the truth yet, but he's arrogant, I can tell you that much.
false
Son, Entrati's Grandson, however, was intent on trying to preserve and study the infested animals.
+10 Chemistry
For shame. I hope that is not true, for his sake and ours. Please continue.
Oh, Sol... did he mean well ?
Quite kind of you. Continuez, s'il vous plaît.
Well, trapped in the Necralisk, and consumed by grief and with no Orokin Empire to rescue them, and now with the Infestation leaking in...
Check /Lotus/Scripts/1999/DialogueScriptNodes.lua:IsSyndicateRank
They turned on each other. Ripped each other apart from the inside out. And the Infestation did the rest. Taking their very names from them.
Yes, I believe he did. I think he honestly cares about the creatures.
true
false
Sadly, it didn't matter, the reckless damage was done.
true
false
No, it was arrogance that inspired him. Even if he claims it was an accident.
true
I don't know the truth yet, but he's arrogant, I can tell you that much.
false
It is the ultimate form of cruelty, to be absent of a name...
+10 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
For shame. I hope that is not true, for his sake and ours. Please continue.
Update boolean MarieFamily2
I wonder what he would make of the Cavia... such a pity he cannot meet them...
If only the purity of one's intentions were all that mattered, the world would be a beautiful place, non ? C'est la vie.
Unless you give it away, like Grandmother.
It's honestly not so bad, you get used to it.
Animals don't have names, and they seem perfectly happy. We give them names simply for our own sake.
I'm smiling at the idea. But I don't think it'd be wise.
I hope that'll happen someday. I really do.
Et ensuite ?
+5 Chemistry
Aaah ! Quelle horreur ! I did not mean ! Oh, I am mortified ! I am so sorry, forgive me, I did not mean - oh, I am a fool !
+5 Chemistry
And why not ?
Add 1 to Family
Now she sounds like a lady I would adore to meet...
How will you make it up to me?
It's all right, I'm only teasing. I'm not upset.
That is quite true ! I never thought of it that way. And you could choose your own. How freeing, in its own sense.
I'm afraid one half will see the other half as "the other family."
The situation upstairs is... fragile on the best of days. I don't want to upset them.
Check /Lotus/Scripts/1999/DialogueScriptNodes.lua:IsSyndicateRank
This has been such a wonderful conversation, but I fear it is my turn to serve luncheon. Monsieur Loid is teaching me how to properly serve tea in his fashion !
Maintenant, vous parlez aussi mal que le diable. No, I will not fall for your tricks.
+5 Chemistry
Add 1 to Family
You would be surprised how resilient the soul is. And those that surround me now are so very old, so very tempered by time.
It can be done. Easier, perhaps than you think. We must just think of how.
true
Oui ? And how goes you or your minuscule copie's work with the famille above ?
false
Chat ends.
Chat ends.
Oh, loué soit Sol ! But it does raise the question... Do you know where you received your moniker ? "Le Drifter ?"
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
We just have to be careful. I'm afraid one half will see the other half as "the other family."
The situation upstairs is... fragile on the best of days. I don't want to upset them.
Slowly. Carefully. I'm afraid one half will see the other half as the "other family."
The situation upstairs is... fragile on the best of days. I don't want to upset them.
I hope I picked it myself.
I don't remember, honestly.
Oh... Par Sol, I think you may have solved it !
You have surprised them many times. Let them surprise you this once.
How freeing would that be ! To pick one's own name. In the Cathédrale, I could not even pick my own clothes. Hah !
So many mystères, you bring with you !
Update boolean MarieFamilyOther
But please, please, s'il vous plaît, continue your story. Your little wolf Marie must know her quarry before she properly hunts, non ?
I am beside myself with excitement - je suis assise ici, remuant sur ma chaise !
Where was I?
That was a little wicked of you, wasn't it?
Perhaps I wish you would hunt me...
Son had invited the Animaux Infestés too close.
Peut-être ! But where is the harm in a little wickedness in the name of good, hm ?
Update boolean DrifterMarie
Right... Anyway, back to the story.
Don't take it the wrong way. I enjoyed it.
You are going to ruin me ! I just squeaked audibly and Monsieur Loid asked if I was all right. I had to lie and say that I saw a mouse, only for him to tell me that we have no mice in this time !
Hah ! I thought you might. Now, enough with your silliness, and back to your story. Son had invited the Animaux Infestés too close, oui ?
+5 Chemistry
Quelle méchanceté, tu es terrible ! Je te déteste et tu me fais rougir maintenant !
Are you mad at me?
Right... Anyway, back to the story.
Non ! Just continue your story !
